title: Arkhe and Saifuro
sub: Technical evaluation proposal for independently verifiable evidence
foot: Restricted discussion draft   /   No production integration asserted

title: The existing evidence boundary
lead: A signed decision is one evidence object
body: Saifuro documents a log and signed verdicts.
The proposed adapter preserves the original statement.
Execution evidence needs a separate source and explicit attribution.

title: Proposed system boundary
bottom: Customer systems retain payment authority. The adapter receives no wallet keys.
note: Architecture proposal. No implementation or custody claim is made.

title: Authorization and settlement
bottom: Unknown, pending, failed and reversed outcomes remain explicit.
note:
https://docs.saifuro.com/reference/verdict-limits
The integration must not infer payment from allow.

title: The signed token boundary
body: Keep the original token and a namespaced digest.
Use a strict, versioned verification profile.
Separate signature validation from transaction claims.
Store provenance for the trust configuration.

title: The escrow envelope question
lead: The public token profile and escrow contract need reconciliation
body: The public JWT uses ES256.
The public limits page describes no aud claim.
The role describes audience verification onchain.
Request the actual escrow envelope before designing a verifier.
note:
https://docs.saifuro.com/reference/verify-a-verdict
https://docs.saifuro.com/reference/verdict-limits
https://saifuro.com/careers/smart-contract-engineer-evm
This is an open question, not a confirmed vulnerability.

title: Mapping to WorkerExecutionRecord
body: module_id and module_version identify the adapter.
input_digest identifies the input envelope.
output_digest identifies the validation report.
evidence_refs links retained source objects.
bottom: A WER does not establish that the underlying purchase executed.
note: Local source: D:/arkhe/kernel/arkhe-core/src/worker.rs. Additional tenant and payment metadata requires an agreed sidecar schema.

title: Offline verification trust
bottom: A bundle cannot reveal current revocations or omitted events without additional evidence.
note: Local source: D:/arkhe/evidence/arkhe-wormgraph/src/anchor.rs. Proposed trust procedure, not Saifuro interoperability evidence.

title: Completeness and policy history
body: Retain export boundaries and expected record counts.
Detect gaps and conflicting event identities.
Do not reconstruct old rules from policy_version alone.
Collect attributable policy evidence if required.
note:
https://docs.saifuro.com/reference/not-built-yet
Proposed reconciliation controls in RFC and pilot plan.

title: Failure handling
lead: No successful evidence receipt after a failed write
body: Duplicates return the existing evidence identity.
Conflicting content enters quarantine.
Missing settlement evidence remains unknown.
Reversals append a linked record.
note: Proposed adapter behavior. Payment handling remains outside this evaluation.

title: Data and disclosure boundaries
body: Start with synthetic records and approved environments.
Keep raw tokens and sensitive metadata access controlled.
Review hashes for privacy and dictionary attacks.
Treat public anchoring as a separate design decision.
note: Data controls are proposals. No DPA roles or international transfer mechanism have been established.

title: Pilot delivery phases
bottom: Proposed four-week planning envelope, subject to access, staffing and signed scope.
note: See 06_PILOT_PLAN_EN.md and 13_STATEMENT_OF_WORK_EN.md. The duration is an estimate.

title: Acceptance evidence
body: Tampered records and untrusted keys reject.
Replays, conflicts and tenant boundaries behave as specified.
Offline verification uses approved retained roots.
Latency and reviewer effort include measurement conditions.
note: Proposed mandatory suite T01 to T18 in 06_PILOT_PLAN_EN.md. No tests of this proposed adapter have been run.

title: IP and licensing boundary
body: Core local manifests declare Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
Version and distribution history need reconciliation.
Private material must be enumerated and lawfully controlled.
New deliverables need an explicit owner and license.

title: People and responsibility
body: Rafael: research, context engineering and specifications.
Experienced engineer: implementation and technical review.
Saifuro: source access, signing profile and product decisions.
Independent reviewer: acceptance evidence and limits.
note: Proposed staffing. The candidate disclosed no production Solidity experience. No team or role allocation has been agreed.

title: Pilot decision
lead: Agreement on scope precedes restricted delivery
body: Confirm identity and contracting parties.
Reconcile IP and choose the appropriate NDA.
Complete the evaluation agreement and SOW.
Decide whether the measured result supports a commercial phase.
note:
https://saifuro.com/legal
Website law does not automatically govern a new transaction. Draft legal terms require completion and review.
